searchText: Grandine will not be ready on Sep 2nd as the refactoring to run each hardfork in a separate runtime is taking more than we expected. We control only ~2% of validators on Prater, so I suggest to hardfork on Sep 2nd and we will catch up later. Is there an official target or rough estimate for pyrmont deprecation? Prater config up for review https://github.com/eth2-clients/eth2-networks/pull/58 Note, Pyrmont is undergoing various scenario tests. The most notable is that most teams ahve turned off 50% of their validators for a few days additionally, we are doing some individual node sync tests, and making sure we hit a good spread of operations If you have performed some scenario testing, please note the test and the results here https://github.com/eth2-clients/eth2-networks/issues/59
